description: This Ressource pack is an addon for MTR and an partition of the Coral Car collection
body:
# Corail IES 143 Extension Pack

This addon expands the Corail Collection with additional infrastructure and operational components based on the IES 143 system.

## Included Content

### IES 143 Control Module
Provides operational controls for the IES 143 system.

### IES 143 Track Geometry
Track geometry elements designed for use with Corail infrastructure.

### IES 143 Catenary Control
Catenary control and management components for advanced railway operations.

## Features

- Detailed models and textures
- Additional infrastructure for Corail operations
- Designed for realistic railway construction
- Fully integrated with the Corail Collection
- Compatible with the MTR France Addon ecosystem

## Requirements

This addon requires:

- Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)


Make sure all dependencies are installed before launching the game.

## Part of the Corail Collection

The Corail IES 143 Extension Pack is one part of the larger Corail Collection, a series of addons dedicated to recreating the iconic French Corail ecosystem.

For the complete experience, be sure to check out the other parts of the Corail Collection, including rolling stock, additional infrastructure and future expansions.

Each component has been designed to work together and provide a comprehensive French railway experience within Minecraft Transit Railway.

## About

The Corail IES 143 Extension Pack provides additional infrastructure and operational systems intended to complement Corail rolling stock and enhance the realism of railway networks.

Enjoy building and operating your railway network!
